newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan February commodity futures volume down 0.7%.
newsitem.headline: Japan February commodity futures volume down 0.7%.

text.p: Futures trading volume on Japan's 10 commodity exchanges totalled 7,859,531 lots in February, down 0.7 percent from the same month a year earlier, but up 16.8 percent from January, the Japan Federation of Commodity Exchanges said on Monday.
Traded volume of Tokyo palladium futures posted the largest increase, totalling 378,428 lots, up 424 percent from January and up 370.3 percent from the previous year, it said.
"The ongoing suspension of Russian exports of platinum and palladium to Japan fuelled speculative interest in platinum group metals, especially palladium futures," an exchange official said.
The Tokyo Grain Exchange's yen-based corn futures contract continued to post the largest turnover in February at 1,620,595 lots.
